scenarios.name: high-power-creature-target-enables-cost-reduction
scenarios.why: Syr's power equals its controller's hand size. After the seven filler cards and the two spells are considered, Syr has power nine when Giant Growth targets it; Not of This World can target that spell and its generic cost is reduced to zero.

scenarios.name: low-power-creature-does-not-reduce-cost
scenarios.why: With only two cards after casting Giant Growth, Syr's power is below seven. The spell targeting it does not qualify for the reduction, so Not of This World is not offered from an empty mana pool.
